verdict.rationale: Nix/NixOS is a declarative package manager and OS that configures system services, so scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never documents any scheduler, timer, or cron-style feature for user jobs or workflows. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: a community note that systemd services are well handled on NixOS, and a mention of enabling auto-gc. Neither shows user-defined recurring job scheduling.
